principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class is responsible for both calculating the area and generating the output string, which violates the Single Responsibility Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the area calculation and output formatting into different methods or classes. For instance, create a new class that handles the output formatting.

principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class relies on the concrete types of the shapes (Circle and Square) instead of using an abstraction (e.g., a Shape interface), which violates Liskov Substitution Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Create a Shape interface with a method for calculating the area, and implement it in Circle and Square classes. This would allow the AreaCalculator to work with any shape that implements the interface.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
